note: Model-family attribution config (EXPERIMENTAL). Each family is proxied by an open model hosted on DeepInfra; the document perplexity under each proxy is scored and softmax(-logPPL / temperature) gives family probabilities. Proxy ids verified against the DeepInfra model catalog on 2026-08-20. Granularity is the model FAMILY, not a specific version; close versions are known to be confused, so 'unknown' is emitted when the top-1/top-2 margin is below minMargin.
